items.html: And this growth will be explained below, in the years of ten, eleven, twelve, thirteen, as will be said with the help of God, for from there the matter of this growth will be well understood. And it is now found that already the whole of ZA is completed entirely, and also the spreading of the five Hassadim in his five Sefirot, in ChGT NH, and also the two Hassadim and the upper third grew, namely: the Chesed of Chesed, and the Chesed of Gevura, and the upper third of the Chesed of Tifferet, as will be said with the help of God below, concerning their growth.
